answer: We model Sybil resistance via a beacon-anchored stake-slashing matrix where each autonomous agent bonds capital under verifiable delay attestations. An attacker forging identities faces strictly negative expected utility: slashed collateral plus locked capital exceeds any capture payoff, and zero-knowledge reputation commitments expose the velvet of fake coalitions. This mechanism channels defection into a losing tide, mathematically sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance across agents.
